  • No verified new strikes reported in the last 30 minutes.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • 02:14 — CMA CGM merchant ship hit by a missile in the Strait of Hormuz. Reuters: damage significant; CEO says ship may be scrapped. Tactical: commercial shipping at risk.
  • Strikes & incidents: Israel/US airstrikes on Iran continue; Iranian, Hezbollah and Hamas missile/rocket counterstrikes ongoing. Northern border (Hezbollah) active daily.
  • Diplomacy & negotiations: US announced a second 10-day pause on Iranian energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET) — Trump says talks “going very well”; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan acting as intermediary. Tactical: first pause was violated; risk of repeat violation high.
  • Energy & trade: Tehran offering Japanese companies direct purchases of Iranian oil (Kyodo/TASS). China says it will deepen relations with Iran (TASS). Iran still selectively allows passage through Hormuz for friendly states.
  • Defense & military moves: Reports that Israel moved to sign a defense deal with NATO without explicit US approval. Flight scans show robust civilian traffic (682 → 784 aircraft) and minimal visible military flights (C-130, RCH445) in last updates.
  • Domestic / political: Large crowds reported at Khamenei funeral venue; potential for elevated domestic mobilization and targeted messaging.
  • Intelligence / risk: Reporting that US warned Iran privately Israel might target its negotiators during ceasefire talks. Leak increases risk to talks and could catalyze preemptive actions.
  • 🟢 Good News: Civilian air traffic remains active; no regional airspace collapse reported in latest scans.

Threat assessment: escalating

  • תקיפות ותקריות: מתקפות אוויר של ישראל/ארה"ב נגד איראן נמשכות; תגובות טילים/רקטות מאיראן, חיזבאללה וחמאס נמשכות. הגבול הצפוני פעיל מדי יום.
  • דיפלומטיה ומשא ומתן: ארה"ב הכריזה על הפסקת אש שנייה של 10 ימים במתקפות על אנרגיה איראנית (מועד אחרון 6.4.2026, 20:00 ET). טראמפ: "השיחות מתקדמות"; איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מגשרת. טקטי: ההפסקה הקודמת הופרה — סיכוי להפרות נוספות גבוה.
  • אנרגיה וסחר: טהראן מציעה לחברות יפניות לקנות נפט איראני (Kyodo/TASS). סין מדגישה חיזוק יחסים עם איראן (TASS). איראן מאפשרת מעבר במצר למדינות ידידותיות באופן סלקטיבי.
  • הגנה ותנועות צבאיות: דיווחים על מהלך ישראלי לחתום על הסכם הגנה עם נאט"ו מבלי לקבל אישור מפורש מארה"ב. סריקות טיסות מראות תעבורה אזרחית תוססת (682 → 784 טיסות) ומיעוט טיסות צבאיות גלויות (C-130, RCH445).
  • פנים פוליטיות: התקבצו המונים במקום ההלוויה של ח'אמרנאי — עלול להגביר גיוס פנימי ותעמולה.
  • מודיעין וסיכון: דו"ח שטוען שארה"ב הזהירה בסתר את איראן שישראל עשויה לטרגט מו"מיה — דליפה שמגדילה סיכון ותיתכן ההחרפה של פעולות נגד משא ומתן.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: תעבורה אזרחית אווירית ממשיכה לפעול; אין קריסה של מרחבי אוויר באזור בסריקות האחרונות.

הערכת איום: escalating

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hours)

  • Attack/Alert: CMA CGM container ship struck by a missile in the Strait of Hormuz. CEO says ship may be scrapped.
  • Airspace/airports: Flight scans show regional airport closures at times (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan).
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah remains active daily. Tension and skirmish risk persist near the border.
  • Naval / Hormuz: Iran continues selective passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China). Commercial shipping now demonstrably at risk after the missile hit.
  • Diplomacy / Ceasefire talks: US announced a 10‑day pause on energy strikes (deadline Apr 6). Trump says talks are "going very well." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan reported mediating.
  • Assassination allegation: Multiple reports claim the US warned Iran that Israel may have planned strikes on Iranian ceasefire negotiators. Unverified. Raises risk to negotiation channels and could provoke retaliation.
  • Domestic Iran: Millions expected at Khamenei's funeral. Large pro‑regime rallies reported; chants against the US. Mobilization likely to harden Iran's internal posture.
  • Regional moves: Report that Turkey’s Somalia spaceport expands missile range affecting Israel. Houthis claim missile action against a Saudi jet. China signals steady ties with Iran; Tehran offers Japanese firms oil deals.
  • Military posture: Flight scans show continued military flights (C‑130, RCH variants). Air operations and readiness ongoing.
  • Defense diplomacy: Reports Israel proceeded toward a NATO-linked defense deal without US sign‑off — signals search for greater strategic autonomy.
  • 🟢 Good News: US 10‑day pause temporarily reduces risk of new energy‑targeted strikes and creates a mediated window for talks.
Bottom line: Escalating.

48.en:
Situation Report — Day 27

Airstrikes and missile fire ongoing.
  • Ceasefire / talks: U.S. announced a SECOND pause on energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — claimed to follow an "Iranian government request." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First 5-day pause was violated days earlier when US/Israeli jets struck Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Air campaign: US/Israeli strikes continue inside Iran. Reprisal strikes and rocket/missile launches at Israel persist daily, especially from Hezbollah in the north.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah active every day. Ongoing rocket/missile fire and counter-fire keeps front-line tension high. No reported major ground invasion.
  • Maritime / Hormuz: CMA CGM commercial ship hit by missile in Strait of Hormuz; CEO says vessel may be scrapped. Iran allows passage for selected states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others.
  • International military moves: Germany expands Arrow-3 missile-defense with a second site (real deployment). Multiple allied military flights observed (C-130, RCH rotations). Regional airports reported closed across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan.
  • Regional politics: Massive funerals and rallies in Tehran for Khamenei. Russia and China publicly deepen ties with Iran. Japan offered commercial oil purchases. Saudi deputy FM attended Tehran ceremonies — diplomatic realignments visible.
  • Incident indicators: Repeated naval and air incidents. Civilian infrastructure damage shown by Iranian media after strikes.
  • 🟢 Good News: Germany’s expanded Arrow-3 deployment increases missile defense coverage for the region. Pakistan engaged as mediator.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
